rename-2026-08-14.what: Page-name pass across all 22 files (44 pages). The <diagram name> attribute of both pages was rewritten to the format 'Sequence|Class - <Name> [UC-xx] [BL#...]', with '(UC-xx sub-flow)' for sub-flows and a comma list for multi-UC pages. This replaced the stale UC-07/09/10/11 numbering, which was present on 18 pages across 9 files.
rename-2026-08-14.scope: The name attribute of the two <diagram> tags in each file. NOTHING else.
rename-2026-08-14.proof: For every file: (a) stripping the name attribute from both <diagram> tags makes the before and after bytes identical; (b) every mxCell is identical on id, value, style, parent and geometry; (c) exactly 2 <diagram> tags differ. 0 files showed any change beyond the name attribute.
rename-2026-08-14.why_not_baseline_moved: A name-only rewrite across 22 files would otherwise produce 22 near-identical baseline_moved paragraphs. baseline_moved stays reserved for content edits (see EvaluateInterviewAnswer, EnterInterviewRoom, EnrollFaceBiometric, ConfigureInterviewSession); a rename records a one-line renamed_by pointer instead.
